user_query: Retrieve the details of the last SMS campaign that I sent. Additionally, fetch the messages I have sent so far, sort them by the date of creation in descending order, and limit the results to 15 messages per page. Finally, validate my phone number for WhatsApp.

TaskList.description: Fetch the details of the last SMS campaign sent by the user.
Retrieve the messages sent by the user, sorting them by creation date in descending order and limiting the results to 15 messages per page.
Validate the user's phone number for WhatsApp.
